google_overhead_review.review: Expanded the overly tight roof opening from approximately 117 by 81 m to 134 by 88 m, without enlarging the pitch. Retained the asymmetric flowing shell and a single consistent translucent band. The Google field is event-covered, so the retained football datum is used, not the event floor perimeter.
